   407  otError LeaderBase::SetNetworkData(uint8_t        aVersion,
   408                                     uint8_t        aStableVersion,
   409                                     bool           aStable,
   410                                     const Message &aMessage,
   411                                     uint16_t       aMessageOffset)
   412  {
   413      otError  error = OT_ERROR_NONE;
   414      Mle::Tlv tlv;
   415      uint16_t length;
   416
   417      length = aMessage.Read(aMessageOffset, sizeof(tlv), &tlv);
   418      VerifyOrExit(length == sizeof(tlv), error = OT_ERROR_PARSE);
   419
   420      length = aMessage.Read(aMessageOffset + sizeof(tlv), tlv.GetLength(), mTlvs);
   421      VerifyOrExit(length == tlv.GetLength(), error = OT_ERROR_PARSE);
   422
   423      mLength        = tlv.GetLength();
   424      mVersion       = aVersion;
   425      mStableVersion = aStableVersion;
   426
   427      if (aStable)
   428      {
   429          RemoveTemporaryData(mTlvs, mLength);
   430      }
   431
   432  #if OPENTHREAD_FTD
   433      // Synchronize internal 6LoWPAN Context ID Set with recently obtained Network Data.
   434      if (GetNetif().GetMle().GetRole() == OT_DEVICE_ROLE_LEADER)
   435      {
   436          GetNetif().GetNetworkDataLeader().UpdateContextsAfterReset();
   437      }
   438  #endif
   439
   440      otDumpDebgNetData("set network data", mTlvs, mLength);
   441
   442      GetNotifier().Signal(OT_CHANGED_THREAD_NETDATA);
   443
   444  exit:
   445      return error;
